objective: Test the XOR-aware native WDSat solver on the exact n=19 frontier models that largely timed out under CaDiCaL.
build: Add an explicit S3-chain n19 capacity profile; preserve the existing default profile.
semantic_input: Combine retained ANF rows with the exact factor-membership CNF clauses. Extend the enhanced parser to accept general CNF clauses, with regression tests.
targets: Use the same 12 target inputs from n19-sat-admission-20260909-a for trace-k7 and sparse-k6.
validation: Parse every complete model, evaluate the original ANF and mixed clauses independently, recover curve points, and verify the point sum. UNSAT must pass the group-addition reachability audit.
admission: At least two certified relations and a lower censoring rate than the 10-second CaDiCaL screen earns a larger matched solver comparison.
scope: Solver implementation evidence only; no mathematical conclusion from timeout or failure.
